color: rgb(253, 230, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INDEX INSULT
Large MI - myocarditis
decompensated HF - valve

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Contractile mass lost
Stroke volume falls

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CARDIAC OUTPUT FALLS
CI under 2.2 L/min/m2

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SYSTEMIC HYPOPERFUSION
MAP falls - lactate rises
oliguria - cool skin

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Blood backs up
LVEDP and PCWP rise
over 15 mmHg

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(251, 207, 232) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CORONARY PERFUSION
PRESSURE FALLS
DBP minus LVEDP

div.style: color: rgb(251, 207, 232) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SNS and RAAS
surge
catecholamines - AngII

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Afterload and heart rate rise
Myocardial O2 demand rises
Na and water retained

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SIRS response
iNOS - NO - peroxynitrite
IL-6 - TNF alpha

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INAPPROPRIATE
VASODILATION
SVR falls - myocardial depression

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MULTI-ORGAN FAILURE
AKI - shock liver
bowel ischaemia - death
